notes.content:

 Metal: Hellsinger Complete Edition – 56% off

notes.title: Metal: Hellsinger VR will be at Save & Sound! Come celebrate music with us!
notes.content:
Hellsingers,

We’re happy to announce that Metal: Hellsinger VR will be at Save & Sound starting November 4th!

Save & Sound is an online music festival with sales and demos on Steam. Come celebrate headbanging soundtracks as well as unique implementations of music and audio in games.

We’ll be participating in the festival with two performances from our famous Gamescom concert.

You can watch the showcase on Bedtime Digital Games’ channels:
 
 Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg 
 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BedtimeDG

We’re excited to share some good music and good times with you. Check out the new trailer for Save & Sound 2024 below!

[previewyoutube=Kud112cK49c;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope you enjoy the festival and see you when it goes live November 4th!

notes.title: Becoming Unknown - Metal: Hellsinger VR | High Score Contest
notes.content:
Greetings Hellsingers,

Last week, we casually dropped the demo for Metal: Hellsinger VR and we hope that you have been enjoying your time in VR Hells.

Let's spice things up a little, shall we?

We are organizing a high-score contest. It's simple. 

- Launch the demo
- Select Stygia - Goat difficulty - Keep it the default song
- Slay to the beat
- Get the highest score and record your gameplay showing the start and the end screens clearly
- Share your gameplay video on X, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram with the hashtag #BecomingUnknown and your name on Steam. You can also upload it to YouTube and share the link on socials. Up to you!
- Stay at the top of the leaderboard and win

We have a leaderboard in the game so you can follow your progress in real time and see how close you are to getting the highest score. You also shouldn't use the Beat Assist Mode!

What about the rewards?


There will be 3 winners.

1st place: Cameo video from Matt Heafy of Trivium and a Metal: Hellsinger VR key for platform of choice
2nd place: Metal: Hellsinger VR key for platform of choice
3rd place: Metal: Hellsinger VR key for platform of choice

Do you have what it takes? Then start working on your demon-slaying game because this contest will be active only until July 17th. 

Time is ticking, Hellsinger. Show them what you're made of.

Note: The entries are going to be curated by our community team and if we notice any exploits or anything suspicious like that, we will have the right to disqualify your entry.

notes.title: Metal: Hellsinger VR Demo Available now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Hellsingers.

For the past year or so, we've been working hard on bringing you a hellishly hot first
look at Metal: Hellsinger VR. We're happy to announce that you can get your hands
on a playable demo right now.

In this demo, you will have access to:

Two levels and their respective tracks

 Voke
 Stygia

Four weapons

 Terminus
 Paz
 Persephone
 The Hounds

And the new VR Lobby we designed for the game. You can access this lobby to
check out your loadout and pick your poison.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948914/c012857035002d12dc1e901febf45e2b33c93b7a.jpg

You can also test out some of our accessibility settings, check out the performance
(which is not final), and have fun while slaying to the beat.

If you haven't seen it, we announced this news at the UploadVR Showcase today
with a brand-new trailer featuring Matt Heafy from Trivium and a release date
pointing at FALL 2024. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=hEA5dKnUj5k;full][/previewyoutube]

Come join our Discord server and become a part of our closely-knit community of
demons.
